categories.main_business_segments: Daelim B&Co operates primarily in manufacturing and selling bathroom-related building materials and products, including sanitary ware, faucets, bathroom remodeling, home care services, and rental of household appliances. Subsidiaries engage in designer living brand management and healthcare and beauty product development and sales. The business is segmented into sanitary ware and faucets, bathroom materials and interior products, rental and other services, and furniture manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes ceramic firing technology for sanitary ware production, including advanced manufacturing methods such as pressure molding and resin molding. It holds patents for water-saving and antibacterial technologies, ergonomic designs, and automated bidet functions. Production involves high-temperature kiln firing and assembly lines for faucets, with continuous R&D focused on product innovation, water-saving, and quality improvements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction companies, dealers, and end consumers in new construction, reconstruction, redevelopment, and remodeling markets. Sales channels cover B2B (construction firms, distributors) and B2C (online and offline retail, direct sales). The company serves domestic and overseas markets, with a focus on enhancing consumer lifestyle quality through bathroom and home interior products.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in South Korea with manufacturing plants in Changwon, Jecheon, and Ansan, and offices in Seoul. The company also exports products to Asian markets and other overseas regions. Subsidiaries operate mainly in Korea, with some international sales for healthcare and beauty products.
categories.supply_chain_position: Daelim B&Co operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing finished bathroom and home interior products and distributing them through B2B and B2C channels. It sources raw materials like minerals and brass domestically and manages product design, production, and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in water-saving technologies, ergonomic and automated bathroom products, and environmentally friendly manufacturing. It maintains a dedicated research institute focusing on product innovation, quality enhancement, and new manufacturing methods. Strategic focus includes expanding product lines with smart and eco-friendly features and sustaining brand leadership through design awards and patents.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of sanitary ware, faucets, bathroom materials, furniture, and home appliances. Additional income comes from rental services of household appliances and related service offerings. Sales occur via B2B contracts with construction firms and dealers, as well as B2C retail channels including online platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Daelim B&Co holds a leading position in the domestic sanitary ware market with a 44.4% market share, ranking first for 20 consecutive years. It competes with other domestic and imported bathroom product manufacturers, leveraging strong brand recognition, quality, and innovation. The company is recognized for its premium product lines and design excellence in the bathroom remodeling sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 266.3 billion, a 5.0% increase from the previous year. Operating profit improved to KRW 4.06 billion with an operating margin of 1.5%. Total assets stood at KRW 347.7 billion with a debt-to-equity ratio of 116.4%. Despite a net loss of KRW 55.5 billion due to financial costs and equity losses, the company shows stable revenue growth and ongoing investment in production and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Daelim B&Co emphasizes superior product quality, advanced water-saving and eco-friendly technologies, ergonomic design, and strong brand reputation. It differentiates through patented innovations like ultra-slim ceramic technology, antibacterial coatings, and automated bidet functions. The company also focuses on comprehensive bathroom solutions, including remodeling and rental services, to enhance customer convenience and lifestyle quality.
